summary:
The M6 alpha of DAGON: Beneath the Black Tide, for Windows, Linux and, for the first time, macOS on Apple Silicon: the intended game, playable from the prologue to the ending and the credits.

It is the game as it stood when its sixth milestone, M6 (stabilization), was merged: commit `b271316`, built and tested by that commit's own CI run. Since `v0.2.0-alpha.1` it adds a fullscreen setting and a window that fits its screen; Settings now calls the examine key Examine, as the prompts do; a drawing misplaced by the Shore's cliff now stands behind the far cliff in the Abyss; the cave's mouth and exit follow the rock; and Continue after the ending no longer stands the sailor in front of a statue. It is the first native Mac build.

**It is unfinished.** The owner tested the Windows package on their own desktop and found no issues; several checks by people are still outstanding, and are listed under "Not tested" below. Read the limitations first.

owner_acceptance.build: The candidate's Windows package, `dagon-v0.2.0-alpha.2-windows-x86_64.zip`, SHA-256 `f76538cc776603806010824ab93f0fb0424a5f90184fd0854af2b98eefd34148`, from artifact 14761047666 of CI run 45038841566 (commit `b271316`), tested by the owner on their Windows desktop
owner_acceptance.scope: On 2026-11-27 the owner accepted the M6 candidate from `b271316` and authorized publishing this version from its source build run, 45038841566. **The owner's own statements, and no others:** they tested the Windows package extensively on their own desktop and found no issues, and their recordings show the display switches, Continue after the ending, and Continue at the Shore within one session. Those recordings have not been reviewed by anyone else. The native run on Ubuntu, frame times on the owner's machines, Continue after a relaunch by a person, and every other check under "Not tested" have not been done. M6 itself was accepted as a milestone on 2026-11-21, on the owner-test build `a30be86` ([record](https://github.com/shamsuzzamansadi/dagon/blob/main/docs/evidence/m6/owner-acceptance-2026-11-21.md)); the owner's approval of this version and its target followed on 2026-11-22 ([record](https://github.com/shamsuzzamansadi/dagon/blob/main/docs/evidence/m6/release-approval-2026-11-22.md)).

known_limitations: **An alpha.** The art and the sound are not final, and anything may change.

**Sound:** every sound is synthesized, and the narration is an AI-generated voice (see `CREDITS.md` in the package). The owner has heard the game in play, but the mix has had no listening review, and whether the reveal's dialogue can be made out over the music and effects has not been judged by ear.
**No first-time player has played it,** and the length of a first playthrough has not been measured. Scripted runs suggest it is shorter than the 10 to 15 minutes the design aims for.

**The Mac build is new:** Apple Silicon only, and signed ad hoc without an Apple developer identity, and not notarized, so macOS blocks its first launch until you allow it (see the README). **What has checked it is CI, on a GitHub-hosted Apple Silicon Mac** (macOS 15.8.2, arm64), **always headless: no window was drawn and no sound was played.** There, the game's code passed its unit tests and its integration tests, also against the exported game's own files; the exported app started, ran New Game and Continue, and quit without an error; and this very zip, unpacked as a Mac unpacks a download, held an app built for arm64 alone whose signature holds, which started, played New Game to a save at the Shore, quit, and continued from that save in a new process. Gatekeeper rejects the app, because it is not notarized. **No person has run it on a Mac,** so how it looks, sounds and plays there, with a keyboard or a controller, has not been checked.
**Controllers:** supported, but the checks on physical hardware listed under "Not tested" have not been done.

**One unresolved report from M2:** in one scripted run on a loaded machine, an examine fired without its caption. It has not been reproduced since, in more than a hundred repeats in CI, and its cause is not established.
**On the software renderer,** the step from the prologue into the game takes one long frame; whether it does on a graphics card is not yet measured.
deferred: Play by two first-time players, and the length of a first playthrough
The reveal's dialogue by ear, in the full mix, on headphones and on speakers
The native run on the owner's Ubuntu laptop, including its display switch and its graphics device, and frame times on either of the owner's machines
Continue after quitting to the desktop and starting the game again, by a person (CI's smoke test of each package does it, headless)
All physical PlayStation hardware, individual physical Xbox actions, including disconnecting and reconnecting, and controller vibration by feel
Any play of the Mac build by a person, on a real Mac
